name: Hadongsuchus
isnote: PBDB places it among the 'protosuchians', a grade rather than a clade, so it is placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Hadongsuchus is a protosuchian-grade crocodyliform known from a skull from the Early Cretaceous Hasandong Formation of Korea.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: A skull from the Hasandong Formation near Hadong, Korea (per the title of the PBDB reference).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Hangjae et al. 2005

sources.text: Y. Hangjae, Y. Yungnam, and Y. Hyesu. 2005. [A new protosuchian (Archosauria: Crocodyliformes) skull from the Hasandong Formation (Lower Cretaceous) of Hadong, Korea]. Korean Journal of Paleontology 21(1):146-150
